text:
Platinum Price in 2020
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2020, the LBMA platinum price rose 11.4% between 2020-01-31 ($959) and 2020-12-30 ($1,068). The highest sampled price was $1,068 in December and the lowest was $727 in March. The mean of these observations was $882. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2020:
COVID-19 and unprecedented monetary stimulus pushed gold above $2,000 per ounce for the first time.
